== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Commander Luke Skywalker (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]], with the PC's bronze disc errata mark, from the starwarsccg.org card lists.

Source: [https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818001135/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif 20190818001135] (18 August 2019); same image on 4 November 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261104102949/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Hoth-Light/large/commanderlukeskywalker.gif archived copy].
